rows.text: A moped leans in a bend: a load that is too low can touch the ground and impair stability. Place it with sufficient ground clearance.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php — Codice della strada art. 170 commi 1 e 5: libertà dei movimenti, fissaggio e limiti di sporgenza per due ruote.

rows.text: An unsecured load can shift or fall, affecting stability or endangering others. It must be firmly secured.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php — Codice della strada art. 170 commi 1 e 5: libertà dei movimenti, fissaggio e limiti di sporgenza per due ruote.

rows.text: A load that projects too far can affect handling and stability. Two-wheeled mopeds also have projection limits measured from the centreline and outline.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php — Codice della strada art. 170 commi 1 e 5: libertà dei movimenti, fissaggio e limiti di sporgenza per due ruote.
https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-164.php — Codice della strada art. 164 comma 1: carico non deve cadere, ostacolare movimenti, compromettere stabilità o mascherare luci e targa.

Ohio MORE Basic Riding Skills Rider’s Guide, pp. 68–69 (PDF pages 75–76), https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/publicsafety.ohio.gov/mop0098.pdf: load affects stability and cornering clearance; weight and location affect steering and stability, and the load must be secured.

rows.text: On a two-wheeled moped the load may project longitudinally at most 50 cm beyond the vehicle outline, not 80 cm.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php — Codice della strada art. 170 commi 1 e 5: libertà dei movimenti, fissaggio e limiti di sporgenza per due ruote.
https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-164.php — Codice della strada art. 164 comma 1: carico non deve cadere, ostacolare movimenti, compromettere stabilità o mascherare luci e targa.

rows.text: For a two-wheeled moped, the lateral limit is 50 cm from the vehicle’s axis, not a maximum of 30 cm. A 30 cm projection is within that dimensional limit, provided the load is securely fastened and does not restrict visibility.
evidence: Official AM supplied PDF page 155, question 27471, prints FALSO and explicitly says “fino ad un massimo di 30 cm”; article 170 sets a 50 cm lateral ceiling from the axis, within which 30 cm falls.

Codice della strada art. 170(1),(5), https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php: for two-wheeled mopeds, objects may not protrude laterally more than 50 cm from the vehicle axis and must be securely fastened without restricting the driver’s view.

ACI Rivista giuridica 2006, Fabio Piccioni, La confisca del ciclomotore e del motoveicolo, p. 2, https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1000001472_02.pdf confirms that 50 cm limit; this is a 2006 commentary, not the 2004 circular.

rows.text: The load need not be attached to the handlebars, mudguards and fork. It must instead be firmly secured without restricting the movements needed to ride.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-170.php — Codice della strada art. 170 commi 1 e 5: libertà dei movimenti, fissaggio e limiti di sporgenza per due ruote.

issues.reason: Il quesito indica come falso che il carico possa sporgere lateralmente fino a 30 cm dall’asse; il limite di 50 cm nell’art. 170 comma 5 comprende 30 cm. La formulazione non afferma che 30 cm sia il limite legale massimo generale. Occorre adjudicazione indipendente del conflitto con il verdetto stampato.

issues: 27467, 27469: The cited Ohio cargo guidance URL https://motorcycle.ohio.gov/rider-safety-resources/motorcycle-operator-manual/carrying-passengers-and-cargo returned HTTP 404 during independent review. Provide an accessible authoritative source supporting the load, ground-clearance and handling claims, or a verifiable local copy of the cited material.

27471: Evidence describes the maximum-limit reading as exclusive ("the claim concerns the maximum, not whether 30 cm itself is allowed"). Although the explicit word massimo supports that reading, the sentence may also be read as permitting a range up to 30 cm; identify the quiz interpretation as such. The learner explanation accurately states that 30 cm is within the dimensional limit.
